description: Rank legal AI tools by fit for a specific practice area and firm size, with a score and the matched factors behind it. Use this instead of search_legal_ai_tools when someone describes their firm (e.g. "solo family law practice" or "20-attorney litigation firm") and wants a recommendation, not just a list.

firm_size.description: Firm size: solo, small (2-10 attorneys), mid (11-50), or large (50+)

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return (1-5, default 5)

practice_area.description: Practice-area category slug — get slugs from list_legal_ai_categories

name: recommend_legal_ai_tools

recommendations.description: Ranked highest-fit first. Empty when nothing in the directory matched either input.

connection.description: Reviewed setup documentation, not a compatibility or security test. Null means no reviewed setup guide is attached, not that a connector cannot exist.

install_command.description: MCP install command, if the tool ships an MCP server

links_verified.description: True if an automated check confirmed every URL on this listing resolved, as of links_verified_at. An automated link check only — NOT an endorsement, security audit, or legal review.

links_verified_at.description: ISO date of the last passing link check; null = not confirmed (often just bot-blocking)

matched_factors.description: The specific reasons this tool scored the way it did, e.g. category or firm-size match

pricing_model.description: One of: free, freemium, paid, contact

pricing_note.description: Informational only, never affects rank: paid/contact tiers often bundle dedicated support that a free/freemium pick may not. Ties are broken by cost alone — this lets the requester weigh support separately.

score.description: Deterministic fit score — see matched_factors for how it was earned

slug.description: Stable listing identifier — pass to get_legal_ai_tool

title: Recommend legal AI tools for a firm
